Name: Jasmine Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from Robokit12, I've updated their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16712]New NPC - Jasmine[/url] to SDV 1.6!

Jasmine actually already knows the farmer, having been their neighbor in Zuzu City! She's also moved to Pelican Town for a career change and to help out her family friends, George and Evelyn, in their golden years. Get to know her and her surprising past!

Jasmine is non-romanceable, as she has a boyfriend in the city. She works at Pierre's. She features optional seasonal portraits and sprites, and lives in the left bottom corner room of the attic from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47209]Saloon Attic and Basement[/url].

This mod is currently pretty bare-bones in terms of events; they're exactly the way they were originally written right now. I plan to flesh them out a bit more in the future so stay tuned.

Enjoy!
